source.renderMethod: PyMuPDF 1.28.2,120 dpi RGB;24 full-page PNGs inspected
source.textMethod: Existing build-cube-type-catalog.py decode_span, then visual confirmation; raw EHsang glyphs never treated as final text
source.answerMethod: Independently derived from source givens; arithmetic programmatically checked; no answer-book joining

pageMapping.evidence: Every rendered footer008 through031 visually checked

schemaNotes: Entry numbers reproduce printed numbers; concept examples use example IDs and unnumbered puzzle uses puzzle.
Each subitem records a source response field, a printed concept example, or an explicitly marked derived checkpoint. Repeated digits in stepwise columns are separate fields.
answers maps stable subitem IDs to exact values; subitems also carry answer for local reading.

role=worked-example means a printed example/explanation; role=response means a source response location (a multi-select can be one array-valued response); role=derived-checkpoint is supporting arithmetic for a selection activity, not an additional printed blank.
Prompts are faithful normalized transcriptions; whitespace/line breaks and decorative copy are not reproduced. All givens, exact arithmetic and answer-bearing visual information are preserved.
visual.data contains semantic reconstruction, not PDF bitmap URLs. Empty visual means no answer-bearing diagram.
No unresolved glyph/render ambiguity remains. Jigsaw answers derive from outline and picture continuity, not an external answer key.
